Package com.neueda.leap.order.execution.quote

Record Class IndicativePriceService.IndicativePriceResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.neueda.leap.order.execution.quote.IndicativePriceService.IndicativePriceResponse
Record Components:
symbol - instrument symbol; null when no quote is available
price - indicative price (quote midpoint); null when no quote is available
quotedAt - time of the cached quote; null when no quote is available
error - error code; null on success
indicative - true when the price is an indicative estimate
Enclosing class:
IndicativePriceService
public static record IndicativePriceService.IndicativePriceResponse(String symbol, BigDecimal price, OffsetDateTime quotedAt, String error, boolean indicative) extends Record
Response object for indicative price queries.
